Seccomp policy for snapshot loading, logging, socket I/O, and shutdown.

# Purpose
This file defines a syscall policy for a snapshot and logging process. It declares file descriptor variables for the log file and for full and incremental snapshot input files, then uses them in rules that control which system calls are allowed on each descriptor. The rules permit logging to `STDERR` and the log file, allow snapshot file reads and seeks, and allow network setup and HTTP-style socket traffic for snapshot download and slot resolution. It also restricts `connect`, `close`, `sendto`, `recvfrom`, and `setsockopt` so they do not act on the log or snapshot file descriptors, and it allows `exit` only with status `0`.
